steps.title: 👋 Welcome to Config Portal
steps.description:
Control your app's behavior without deploying code. Toggle features for specific users, roll out gradually, and schedule changes — all from this dashboard.

Example: Ship a new checkout flow to 10% of users, then ramp up as you gain confidence.

steps.title: Start with a project
steps.description: A project represents one app or service. For example: 'Web App', 'Mobile API', or 'Admin Dashboard'. Click to create yours.

steps.title: 🌍 Environments keep things safe
steps.description:
Environments let you test changes in 'staging' before they hit 'production'. Most teams use 2-3: development, staging, and production.

This way, turning on a feature in staging won't affect your real users.

steps.title: Create an environment in Settings
steps.description: Head to Settings → Environments to add 'production' or 'staging'.

steps.title: 🚀 Your first feature flag
steps.description:
A config can be a boolean (on/off), a string, number, or even JSON. Use cases:

• feature.dark_mode = true (toggle a UI feature)
• app.max_upload_mb = 10 (tune a limit without deploying)
• feature.checkout_v2 = false (hide unfinished work)

steps.title: Open Configs
steps.description: This is where you manage all your feature flags and remote values.

steps.title: Add a config
steps.description: Click here. Try creating a boolean flag like 'feature.new_checkout' with value 'false'.

steps.title: 🎉 You're live!
steps.description:
Your config is saved. From here you can:

• Expand a config to add targeting rules (serve different values to different users)
• Set up a gradual rollout (10% → 50% → 100%)
• Schedule a future value change

Next: grab an API key to connect your app.
